metadata.description: Local single-plugin marketplace for the Workflow Workarounds plugin. Add this folder as a marketplace, then install workflow-workarounds from it.

plugins.name: workflow-workarounds
plugins.description: Two general workarounds for platforms that block clean programmatic access: an authenticated API proxy through a Make.com webhook (for anything an account can reach behind OAuth), and a method for building deterministic browser automations for web workflows that have no usable API.
